name: Curated OAIC data-breach regulatory actions
regulator: Office of the Australian Information Commissioner
unit_of_observation: One manually reviewed legal-status event supported by a fixed official OAIC page
source_threshold: Selective official regulatory publications relevant to public data-breach activity.
source_population: Reviewed preliminary inquiries, investigations, enforceable undertakings, determinations and court actions.
public_window: Versioned curated manifest; not a complete index of every OAIC action.
source_licence: OAIC website material is generally Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Australia unless an exclusion applies; each source must retain attribution and source wording.
attribution: Office of the Australian Information Commissioner
correction_process: Review the official OAIC page and update the curated manifest only after legal-status review.
limitations: The timeline is selective rather than exhaustive.
Proceedings and allegations are not findings.
An enforceable undertaking is not automatically a finding of breach.
